subject: Items
text: You can replenish the 4 numbered items in the top row, but you cannot carry more than 99 of them.

evidence.quote:
You can replenish these
4 numbered ITEMS, but you can't carry more than 99 of them.

subject: Magic
text: There are 3 major classes of magic: White, Black, and Wizard, with 4 different spells within each of these categories.

evidence.quote:
There are 3 major classes of magic : WHITE, BLACK, and WIZARD. There are 4
different SPELLS within each of these categories.

subject: Hero
text: The Hero can use 4 classes of weapons: Swords, Axes, Claws and Bombs, and only the strongest weapon in each class can be used.

evidence.quote:
The Hero can use 4 classes of weapons: Swords, Axes, Claws and Bombs. When
you win or find a stronger WEAPON, it will automatically be equipped onto
the Hero. Only the strongest WEAPON in each class can be used.

subject: Weapons
text: Supplies of certain weapons, such as Explosives and an ally's Ninja Stars, are limited and must be replenished throughout the game.

evidence.quote:
Supplies of certain WEAPONS, such as Explosives and your ally's Ninja Stars
are limited, and must be replenished throughout the game.

subject: Special Defense
text: Special defense icons include Doom, Petrify, Paralyze, Sleep, Confusion, Poison, Blind, and Silence.

evidence.quote:
Icons include : (Top row) Doom, Petrify, Paralyze, Sleep, (Bottom row)
Confusion, Poison, Blind, and Silence.

subject: ACCURACY
text: For Accuracy, the higher the number, the more damage you will do to an enemy.

evidence.quote:
ACCURACY The higher the number, the more damage
                      you'll do to an  enemy.

subject: EVADE
text: For Evade, the higher the number, the better your chances are of running from battle.

evidence.quote:
EVADE    The higher the number,the better your
                      chances of running from battle.
